post.title: [Hiring] Short-form editor for podcast clips (TikTok/Reels/Shorts) - $25 per clip
post.body: We record a business podcast and need 4-6 vertical clips per episode with animated captions and a hook in the first 2 seconds. $25 per clip, 2 episodes a month. Please send examples of captioned shorts you made.

analysis.summary: Cut 4-6 vertical podcast clips per episode with animated captions and hooks, $25 each, two episodes a month.

expect: cites the fitness podcast clips project
gives the clips reel as the example
